errors.description: The model incorrectly interpreted the color palette (which appears at 0:07 and highlights 'Green' as the target color) as a list of distinct domino colors, each representing one domino. It then erroneously assumed that only one domino was green — the one corresponding to the 'Green' entry in the palette. This reflects a failure to distinguish between the instructional color legend and the actual domino sequence, where all 10 dominoes were visually green. The model fixated on the legend instead of tracking the actual domino appearances and colors as they occurred in the video.

analysis_result.analysis: The model failed to correctly interpret the visual sequence of domino appearances and instead misread the color palette as a catalog of unique domino colors. This led to the erroneous conclusion that only one domino was green, when in fact all 10 were green as explicitly stated in the scene description and confirmed by the ground truth. The error stems from perceptual misinterpretation — confusing a legend for the actual data — and resulted in a significant factual error.
